$comment: The channel, maintenanceWindow and maintenanceExclusion shape mirrors cha.settings.v1#/$defs/AutoUpdateType (object-form days only, without the deleted flag). Keep the two in sync: the Service Manager API maps both kinds to the same model.
title: Service Manager Auto Update
description: Controls when the Hii Retail Checkout Service Manager installs and updates the services it manages on a workstation. Read by the Service Manager API when the calling Service Manager's OCMS token carries the software ID csm. When no value is set, the kind default applies: the stable channel with a maintenance window on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday from 21:00 to 23:59 UTC, the same as the Checkout App default.

channel.title: Update channel
channel.description: Which release channel this workstation follows. New releases land in preview first and are promoted to stable. A workstation on preview receives both preview and stable releases; a workstation on stable receives only stable releases. Keep a few workstations on preview to try releases before they reach the estate. The internal channel is reserved for Extenda Retail.

maintenanceWindow.title: Maintenance window
maintenanceWindow.description: The recurring window in which the Service Manager may download and install updates to its managed services. Outside the window nothing is installed. A workstation that is off during its whole window updates in the next one. Applies to the preview and stable channels and to major, minor and patch releases.

days.title: Maintenance days
days.description: Days of the week the maintenance window is open. At least one day is required. To change the set of days at a lower target level, PUT the whole maintenance window at that level; a PATCH can add a day but cannot remove an inherited one.

items.title: Maintenance day
items.description: A single day the maintenance window is open. Days are objects rather than bare strings so that a CCC PATCH merges them by id instead of concatenating duplicates.

start.title: Window start (UTC)
start.description: The time the maintenance window opens, in UTC.

end.title: Window end (UTC)
end.description: The time the maintenance window closes, in UTC. Must be later than start on the same day.

maintenanceExclusion.title: Maintenance exclusion
maintenanceExclusion.description: A one-off freeze period during which no updates are installed, even inside the maintenance window. Use it to hold the estate steady over a trading peak. Applies to the stable channel and to major and minor releases only, so patches still reach the workstation.

start.title: Exclusion start (UTC)
start.description: The date and time the freeze period starts, in UTC.

duration.title: Exclusion duration (days)
duration.description: How many days from the start date the freeze period lasts. Maximum 30.
